text:
Alex: heads-up — i'm prototyping a new grafana row to show slot fallthroughs + deployment visibility for GPU pools. goal: one glance shows tenants that tried to get warm slots, fell back, and whether that correlated with kvcache misses or thermal throttles.
Maya: love that. do you want discrete sparklines per-tenant or a compact heatmap rollup?
Alex: compact rollup at the top (sparklines for top 10 noisy tenants) + per-tenant drilldown panels. main thing is an event overlay for "slot fallthrough" and "eviction" spikes.
Samir: for the fallthrough metric do we have a single event? we currently emit `scheduler_slot_request{outcome="fallthrough"}` as a counter. can do rate() but recording rule might be nicer.
Maya: agreed — suggestion: create recording rule `gpus:slot_fallthrough_rate:5m = rate(scheduler_slot_request{outcome="fallthrough"}[5m])` then you can use `topk(10, sum by(tenant)(gpus:slot_fallthrough_rate:5m))` for the sparklines.
Jess: also correlate with `kvcache_miss_ratio` and `gpu_temp_celsius` derived 99th percentile. overlay markers on sparklines when `increase(evictions_total[5m]) > 0`.
Alex: putting that into a panel:
```
# Top tenants by 5m fallthrough rate
topk(10, sum by(tenant)(gpus:slot_fallthrough_rate:5m))
```
Maya: for the event overlay use a secondary query to return instant vectors with label `event=fallthrough` e.g. `sum by(tenant) (increase(scheduler_slot_request{outcome="fallthrough"}[5m])) > 0`. Grafana will show dots.
Samir: we should also expose a per-region split: fallback to remote region increases tail latency. so panel rows: global rollup, region split, node-level (single rack) micro view.
Alex: layout plan: row 1: rollup sparklines top-10 tenants + event dots. row 2: heatmap of tenant x region fallthrough density (24h). row 3: kvcache hitratio vs token latency scatter + optional regression line. row 4: node detail: thermal + power alongside fallthrough marker events.
Jess: alerting idea: have a composite alert if `sum by(tenant)(gpus:slot_fallthrough_rate:5m) > 0.02` AND `avg_over_time(kvcache_miss_ratio[10m]) > 0.15` for 10m -> page oncall. threshold numbers are fuzzy — we should run backtests on last 30 days to tune.
Maya: +1 on backtest. we can create a notebook that replays metrics and computes false positive rate per threshold. i can take that.
Samir: panel performance note: avoid heavy instant queries on dashboard load. use precomputed recording rules and rollups (1m -> 5m). for heatmaps use `increase(...[24h])` with downsampling via `sum_over_time` recording rules.
Alex: UX ask: add a small legend that decodes event dot colors: orange=fallthrough, red=eviction, purple=thermal-throttle. also add link to tenant's provisioning history (internal app).
Jess: for thermal-throttle detection rule: `gpus:thermal_throttle_events:1h = increase(gpu_thermal_throttles_total[1h])`. mark nodes with >0 as tainted in node view.
Alex: would like an ops play snippet in the dashboard description for fast mitigation steps: `- check rack inlet temp; - move latency-sensitive tenants to warm pool; - bump autoscale or retry policy`
Maya: storage note: save dashboard JSON model in `grafana/dashboards/observability/slot-fallthrough.json` and link in the dashboard description. i'll own saving the JSON once we agree layout.
Samir: do we want a cheap cost estimation panel? e.g. approximate extra GPU-hours wasted by fallthroughs = `sum_over_time(slot_fallthroughs[1h]) * avg_slot_duration_hours` and multiply by region cost per GPU. that helps SRE & finance.
Alex: yes — call it "Estimated wasted GPU-hours (24h)" and show a sparkline + single stat of dollars. include per-region breakdown.
Jess: quick grafana tips: use `series override` to make event dots stand out and use shared crosshair so you can correlate spikes across rows.
Alex: ok next steps: Maya will prototype recording rules + backtests, Samir will prepare region split queries and node-level series, Jess will draft alerts and dashboard JSON template. i'll wire up the event overlay and UX.
Maya: milestone: prototype in staging grafana by EOD Thu. will ping here when ready. @Samir @Jess please lmk blockers.
Samir: will need a short-lived scrape target increase to capture 1s samples for a 6h window during testing — filing infra ticket.

Alex: awesome, thanks all. we'll iterate after the staging run and synthetic replay. :rocket:
